target_customer: Consumer brands and ingredient suppliers in beauty, wellness and food and beverage that need to anticipate trends
problem: Brands launch products on stale trend reports. Spate uses search and social data to forecast which trends will rise or fall over the next 12 months.
business_model: B2B SaaS subscription for trend data, reports and API access

founders.name: Yarden Horwitz
founders.background_notes: YC page lists a former Google background; the Spate company page says both founders were on the team behind Google's Trendspotting division.

founders.name: Olivier Zimmer
founders.background_notes: Spate company page says he was on Google's Trendspotting team. The YC page lists no background.

competitors.name: WGSN
competitors.what: Established trend forecasting agency covering fashion, beauty and food
competitors.traction_then: Named by a March 2018 Coresight profile as a main trend-forecasting rival of the Heuritech startup

competitors.name: Heuritech
competitors.what: French machine learning startup forecasting fashion trends from social images
competitors.traction_then: Launched a trend forecasting platform in 2018 per its own timeline
competitors.funding_then: About 4 million euros around 2018 per its own timeline

technical_complexity.rationale: Requires large search and social data pipelines and forecasting models, with credibility depending on backtested accuracy rather than a hard technical breakthrough.

defensibility.rationale: Data sources (Google, TikTok, Instagram) are accessible to competitors, so advantage rests on model quality and accumulated track record.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: Google Trends and incumbent forecasters existed but no source shows them copying the product. No acquisition was found.

market_need_then: Brands in beauty and food relied on agency trend reports. Spate's pitch cites trends it spotted early such as turmeric, face masks and cold brew from its founders' Google Trendspotting work.

identity.voice_and_tone: Data-driven and authoritative; claims 72 percent prediction accuracy

branding.brand_signature: The Spate Popularity Index and trend reports
branding.community_and_virality: Company claims 200+ media mentions and 50+ trend reports on its site; not independently verified.

brand_strength.rationale: A short real-word name with trade press coverage of its reports, but a name search returns fashion brand Kate Spade results and no independent brand coverage was found.

outcome_analysis: Spate is still operating and now lists enterprise customers such as L'Oreal, Estee Lauder and Unilever on its own site, built on the founders' Google trendspotting experience. Known funding is a $1.8M seed in June 2019, small for a company of its stated size, and no later rounds were verified. It looks like a capital-light B2B data business that grew through sales rather than big venture rounds, but the evidence is mostly company-reported.
notes: CB Insights labels the 2019 round Series A and lists $1.92M total over two rounds; Seedtable and Bounce Watch say seed at $1.8M. The Medium and Initialized Capital page returned HTTP 403. Competitor sources: the Coresight page names WGSN and Nelly Rodi as Heuritech rivals, so WGSN is listed as an incumbent in the trend forecasting space and Heuritech as a startup in the same space, not as head-to-head Spate rivals; the page was seen only as a search result and not opened. Spate was not named in it. Claims of 200+ brands and 72 percent accuracy are company claims.
